contract:
## Shared Types

- **TimerState** (object): `{ mode: 'work' | 'break', timeRemaining: number (seconds), isRunning: boolean, workDuration: number, breakDuration: number, sessionCount: number }`
- **TimerMode** (type): `'work' | 'break'`
- **Custom Events** (dispatched on `document`):
  - `timer:state-changed` – detail: `TimerState`
  - `timer:tick` – detail: `TimerState`
  - `timer:finished` – detail: `{ mode: TimerMode }`
  - `timer:mode-changed` – detail: `{ mode: TimerMode }`

## API Contract (Interfaces)

All JavaScript modules use ES6 `export` and are loaded with `<script type="module">`.

### `pomodoro/timer.js`
Default export class `PomodoroTimer`:
- `constructor(config: { workDuration?: number, breakDuration?: number, onStateChange?: (state: TimerState) => void, ... })`
- `start()`
- `pause()`
- `reset()`
- `skip()`
- `getState(): TimerState`
- `setDuration(mode: TimerMode, seconds: number)`
The timer internally calls `tick()` every second, dispatches `timer:state-changed`, `timer:tick`, `timer:finished`, and `timer:mode-changed` events on `document`.

### `pomodoro/visuals.js`
Exports:
- `initVisuals(): (state: TimerState) => void`
- `updateVisuals(state: TimerState)` (the returned function)
- (optional) `playAnimation(type: string)` for special animations

### `pomodoro/sound.js`
Exports:
- `initSounds()`
- `playTick()`
- `playAlarm()`
- `playStart()`
All sounds are synthesized via Web Audio API; no external files required.

### `pomodoro/settings.js`
Exports:
- `Settings` class:
  - `constructor(defaults?: object)`
  - `load(): object`
  - `save(state: object): void`
  - `get(key: string): any`
  - `set(key: string, value: any): void`
  - `onChange(callback: (changed: object) => void)`
  - default values: `{ workDuration: 1500, breakDuration: 300, soundEnabled: true, backgroundTheme: 'default' }`
- `initSettings(): void` (binds UI elements in settings panel to Settings instance, updates timer on change)

### `pomodoro/background.js`
Exports:
- `initBackground(): void` (fetches background image from `https://api.nanobanana2.com/generate?prompt=pomodoro&theme=...` or similar, applies as full-screen background)
- `updateBackground(theme: string): void` (re-fetches with new theme)

## Naming Conventions

- **CSS classes**: prefix `pm-` (e.g., `pm-timer`, `pm-controls`, `pm-settings`, `pm-svg-ring`). Use kebab-case.
- **JS variables/functions**: camelCase.
- **File names**: lowercase with hyphens (already defined).
- **HTML id attributes**: also prefix with `pm-` (e.g., `pm-timer-display`, `pm-start-btn`).
- **Event names**: use `timer:` namespace for timer events.

subtasks.task: User can start, pause, reset, and skip a Pomodoro timer (work/break cycle). A basic text countdown is visible.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Start begins the countdown from 25:00; display updates every second.
Pause halts the countdown without resetting the time.
Reset stops the timer and resets to 25:00.
Skip immediately switches from work to break (or break to work) and resets the duration.
When timer reaches 0, an alert or console log indicates the end and the mode cycles (work -> break -> work).
The timer dispatches custom events `timer:state-changed`, `timer:tick`, `timer:finished`, and `timer:mode-changed` on `document`.

subtasks.task: User sees an iOS‑style SVG progress ring that smoothly animates as the timer counts down, with colour changes between work and break modes.
acceptance_criteria: An SVG ring is rendered inside #pm-ring-container with a stroke that represents 0–100% of the current mode's duration.
The ring’s stroke colour is red for work and green for break.
When the timer ticks, the ring updates proportionally with a smooth transition (CSS transition or requestAnimationFrame).
The time display text updates every second and is visually integrated with the ring.
Layout is responsive and follows iOS design cues (e.g., large timer text, centred controls).

subtasks.task: User hears a tick sound every second while the timer is running, an alarm when a session ends, and a start sound on play — all synthesised without external files.
acceptance_criteria: A tick sound plays each time the `timer:tick` event fires (every second while running).
An alarm sound plays when `timer:finished` is dispatched.
A short start sound plays when the timer transitions from paused/stopped to running.
Sound enabling/disabling is controlled by the `soundEnabled` setting (checked via Settings instance); when disabled, no audio is produced.
All sounds are generated via Web Audio API (no `<audio>` elements or external files).

subtasks.task: User can customise work/break durations, toggle sound, and choose a background theme; these preferences are saved and survive page reloads.
acceptance_criteria: The settings panel is toggled open/closed by clicking the settings toggle button.
Changing the Work Duration (minutes) and Break Duration (minutes) inputs and clicking Save immediately updates the timer durations (via timer.setDuration).
The Sound checkbox enables/disables sound globally (the sound module reacts to the setting).
The Background Theme select box triggers a background refresh via updateBackground.
All settings are stored in localStorage and restored on page reload.
The timer's initial durations reflect the saved settings.

subtasks.task: User sees an AI‑generated background image (via nano banana2 API) that changes when the theme is switched.
acceptance_criteria: On app load, the background layer (#pm-background-layer) is filled with an image fetched from `https://api.nanobanana2.com/generate?prompt=pomodoro&theme=default` (or an equivalent proxy).
When the background theme is changed in settings, `updateBackground(theme)` fetches a new image and applies it as the background.
If the image fetch fails, a fallback solid colour (light grey) is shown and an error is logged.
The image covers the full viewport without distortion (e.g., background-size: cover, background-position: centre).
